_doc: Round-2 settings per challenge. Stages run in order on the latent of invrs_wakis.lengthscale.FeasibleDensity (conic filter radius filter_radius px, tanh projection with sharpness beta). 'lbfgsb' stages optimize the gray projected density; 'ste' stages simulate the length-scale-repaired binary design (straight-through gradient), so every evaluated design is feasible. weights: {resolution: weight} of the Wakis objective (1 = 40 nm gym grid with the official-matching 'ceviche' port estimator; 2 = 20 nm, 'modal' estimator). The best n_candidates feasible designs (Wakis r=1 eval metric) are scored with the official gym backend; the best official one is kept.

schedule_v2._doc: v2 schedule for the full ceviche challenges and the metalens: eroded/nominal/dilated robust projection (delta = 0.15) at beta = 8, 16, then 60-step STE Adam at beta = 16 (lr = 0.005)

metalens._doc: GPU (L4): beta stages on the 20 nm uniform grid (~26 s/gradient), STE stage with the 10 nm (r=2) robustness term (~210 s/gradient); length-scale target = the gym's seed density minimum width/spacing

ceviche_waveguide_bend._doc: full challenge: 10 nm grid, 6 wavelengths, 8 px targets; the Wakis r=1 grid is the official 10 nm grid (36 cells/lambda in Si), so no finer robustness term (r=2 = 5 nm would cost 8x) and tensor smoothing is a no-op at r=1

schedule_v3._doc: v3 (default for the reruns): no robust stages (they did not shrink the repair drop, see README); gentle STE from beta = 16 at lr = 0.005
